ns2:section.sectionText: This is a blended section: class meetings (2 hrs.) constitute part of the credit hour requirement, the rest is met by weekly online, web-based work (1 hr.) Students must meet the prerequisite requirements for this course (found in the Catalog Entry) or will be told to drop on the first day of classes. This class typically meets 2 hours per week in class. For Fall 2020 these meetings will take place via Zoom. Additional weekly online assignments will also be required. Non registered students are not allowed to sit-in or audit.
